name: Nyíradony (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nyíradony (a green shield with a tree and a sabre, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name NYÍRADONY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyíradony arms with helm, crest and mantling
